      Alimentary canal slider · 消化道滑桿 Mouth cavity 口腔

      Fat stays undigested at the start of the small intestine until bile emulsifies it. In this syllabus model, digestion finishes in the small intestine; the large intestine absorbs water and compacts faeces.
